blocks.title: Cis-trans isomers
blocks.text: Cis-trans isomers woh stereoisomers hain jin ke atoms ki khala mein tarteeb is liye mukhtalif hai ke khuli zanjeer wale compound mein double bond par gardish ruki hui hai.

Pehle butane ko dekhein. C2-C3 single bond par gardish methyl groups ki aik tarteeb ko doosri mein badal deti hai. Aisi shakalein conformational isomers hain: yeh C-C single bond par gardish se aazadi se aik doosre mein badalti hain aur kamre ke darja hararat par alag nahi ki ja saktin.

But-2-ene, CH3-CH=CH-CH3, mein carbon 2 aur 3 sp2 hybridised hain. C=C double bond aik sigma bond, jo sp2 hybrid orbitals ke seedhe milap se banta, aur aik pi bond, jo p orbitals ke pehlu ba pehlu milap se banta, par mushtamil hai. Pi bond molecule ko jakar deta hai: double bond ke dono carbon aur un se jure groups aik plane mein aur khala mein qaim hain. Double bond par ghoomne ke liye pi bond ko tootna parega, jis ke liye taqreeban 263 kJ/mol chahiye, jo kamre ke darja hararat par dastiyab nahi. Yahi ruki hui gardish cis-trans isomerism ki jar hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: do sp2 carbons jin ke khare p orbitals C-C bond ke oopar aur neeche mil kar pi bond banate, har carbon par H aur CH3. Oopar daen: aik carbon ke chauthai chakkar ke baad us ka p orbital leta hua aur milap khatam. Neeche: cis-but-2-ene jis mein dono CH3 groups C=C ki aik taraf, aur trans-but-2-ene jis mein ulti taraf.
blocks.caption: But-2-ene mein C=C par ruki gardish (Figure 19.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Pi bond sirf tab tak hai jab dono p orbitals mutawazi hon. Molecule ka aik sira ghumane se yeh milap khatam ho jayega, is liye har carbon ke groups apni jagah rehte hain. Natija yeh ke cis-but-2-ene aur trans-but-2-ene alag compounds hain jo kamre ke darja hararat par aik doosre mein nahi badalte.

items: Cis isomer: do milte julte groups double bond ki aik hi taraf (cis-but-2-ene).
Trans isomer: do milte julte groups ulti taraf (trans-but-2-ene).
Agar double bond ke kisi carbon par do aik jaise groups hon to cis-trans isomerism mumkin nahi, maslan but-1-ene (CH2=CH-CH2CH3) aur 2,3-dimethylbut-2-ene ((CH3)2C=C(CH3)2).

blocks.title: Cis-trans isomerism ki shart
blocks.text: Khuli zanjeer wala compound cis-trans isomerism dikhata hai agar us mein double bond ho aur double bond ke har carbon par do mukhtalif groups hon.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Cis aur trans isomers ki tabeei aur kimiyai khasiyatein mukhtalif hain: pighalne aur ubalne ke darje, dipole moments, kasafat aur bukharat ki hararat mukhtalif. Trans isomer aam taur par cis se zyada mustahkam hota hai, is liye reactivity bhi mukhtalif hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Pent-2-ene cis-trans isomerism dikhata hai lekin pent-1-ene nahi. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Pent-1-ene (CH2=CH-CH2CH2CH3) mein carbon 1 par do H atoms hain, is liye sirf aik tarteeb hai; pent-2-ene mein double bond ke har carbon par do mukhtalif groups (H aur alkyl group) hain.

items: Single bonds aazadi se ghoomte (conformations); C=C ka pi bond gardish rokta (todne ko taqreeban 263 kJ/mol).
Cis: milte julte groups aik taraf; trans: ulti taraf.
C=C ke har C par do mukhtalif groups chahiye.
